author: MandaloreGaming
description:
The BioShock 2 Review covers the sequel to Ryan's Rapture fun hours where the city has fallen into a post apocalyptic state led by Dr. Lamb and her endless therapy speak. Can a big daddy be a better parent than a psychologist? I don't know but the remaster doesn't come with multiplayer which is surprisingly alive.
